descricoes.explorar: Look up the trail of any batch, credit or distribution.
descricoes.lotes: Combine source lots of the same material, weigh the consolidated lot and list it in the auction.
descricoes.anuncios: List batches on the marketplace, reprice or withdraw listings.
descricoes.retiradas: Confirm the custody handover between cooperative and carrier.
descricoes.entregas: Batches in transit and delivery deadlines.
descricoes.compras: Winning bids and sales awaiting signature.
descricoes.recebimentos: Confirm receipt and the weight on arrival.
descricoes.disputas: Open or follow disputes on your batches.
descricoes.direitos: What you are owed in coupons from sold credits.
descricoes.participantes: Register the wallets of collectors, cooperatives, carriers and industries.
descricoes.balancas: Register the scales of cooperatives and industries.
descricoes.leiloes: Close auctions without bids and record winners.
descricoes.creditos: Build credits from recycled batches and submit them for validation.
descricoes.distribuicoes: Publish the revenue split for each sold credit.
descricoes.escrow: Attest batch escrow deposits, releases and refunds.
descricoes.vendasCredito: Attest receipt of payment for credit sales.
descricoes.repasses: Record transfers to Zupy and EcolChain.
descricoes.validacao: Record issuance or rejection in the official registry.
descricoes.aposentadorias: Record the retirement of sold credits.
descricoes.materiais: Register the material types accepted in batches.
descricoes.coletas: Weigh and record incoming material: from collectors, in-house sorting, donations, purchases or unregistered pickers.
descricoes.meusLotes: The source lots you delivered, at any cooperative, and the path of each one to the industry.
descricoes.minhaCarteira: Your wallet code to show the cooperative at delivery.

rede.indisponivel: Could not reach {{rede}}. Check your connection or switch networks.

carteira.nenhuma: No Solana wallet found in this browser. Install one (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack) and reload the page.
carteira.erro: The wallet declined the connection. Try again.

painel.boasVindas: Track every batch from collection to recycling and follow what you are owed from carbon credits.
painel.conecte: Connect your wallet to see the operations for your registration.
painel.emDefinicao: The dashboard content is still being defined.

paginas.emConstrucao: This screen is still under construction.

admin.soAdministracao: This screen is only for the platform administration wallet.

participantes.nomeAjuda: Shown in lists. It is public on the blockchain: for collectors, prefer a nickname or code.
participantes.referenciaAjuda: E.g.: contract number. Only a code derived from it goes on the blockchain, never the text.
participantes.umPapel: Each wallet has a single role, which cannot be changed later.

balancas.dispositivoAjuda: Public address generated by the device itself.
balancas.semDonos: First register a cooperative or industry in Participants.
balancas.nomeAjuda: Helps find the device in lists. It is public on the blockchain.

erros.generico: The transaction failed. Try again shortly.
erros.semSaldo: Not enough balance in the wallet to pay the fee.
erros.jaExiste: A registration with this data already exists.
erros.NaoEhOperador: This wallet is not the administration wallet.
erros.NomeInvalido: Name is empty or longer than 32 characters.
erros.CarteiraReservada: This wallet is reserved for platform use and cannot be a participant.
erros.PapelIncorreto: The participant does not have the required role.
erros.ParametroInvalido: One of the values is invalid.
erros.BalancaDeOutroDono: The scale belongs to another participant.
erros.PesoConsolidadoForaDaFaixa: The consolidated lot weight is outside the accepted range over the total of the source lots.
erros.EntregaDeOutroLote: One of the source lots belongs to another sale lot.
erros.LoteSemEntregas: The lot has no source lots yet.
erros.EntregaJaVinculada: One of the source lots is already in another sale lot. Refresh and try again.
erros.MaterialDiferente: All source lots must be of the same material as the sale lot.
erros.TransicaoInvalida: This action does not apply to the lot’s current status. Refresh the page.
erros.PesagemDivergente: The weighing signed by the scale does not match the data sent.

cooperativa.soCooperativa: This screen is only for cooperative wallets.

balanca.semBalanca: To weigh, this cooperative needs a scale. On devnet, use a test scale generated in this browser.
balanca.naoCadastrada: Scale not registered yet. Ask the administration to register it under Scales, with this cooperative as owner.
balanca.outroDono: This scale is registered to another wallet.
balanca.inativa: Scale registered but deactivated by the administration.
balanca.pronta: Scale registered and active. Ready to weigh.
balanca.aviso: Test scale: the key is stored in this browser. In real operation, the device itself signs each weighing.

coletas.semColetores: No collectors registered. Ask the administration to register collector wallets under Participants.
coletas.balancaNaoPronta: The scale must be registered and active to record source lots.
coletas.referenciaObrigatoria: Invoice, receipt or tax ID. Only a derived code goes on the blockchain. Keep the text: the donor uses it to find the lot in the public trail.
coletas.referenciaOpcional: Optional: ticket or internal note. Only a derived code goes on the blockchain.

lotes.semBalanca: Generate the test scale in Source lots before assembling lots.
lotes.evidenciasAjuda: Invoice, receipt or scale ticket number. Only a code derived from it goes on the blockchain; with the text, anyone can find the lot in the public trail.
lotes.escolherEntregas: Available source lots of this material
lotes.semEntregas: No source lots of this material available.
lotes.pesoFardo: Consolidated lot weight on the scale (kg)
lotes.pesoFardoAjuda: Accepted from {{min}} to {{max}} kg. Empty uses the total.
lotes.passo: Sending {{n}} of {{total}}… confirm in your wallet.
lotes.foraDaFaixa: Outside the accepted range: {{min}} to {{max}} kg.
lotes.desfazerTexto: The {{n}} source lot(s) become available for another sale lot and the lot’s digital receipt is burned. After the sale, it can no longer be undone.

trilha.buscaExemplo: E.g.: Collector 1, invoice 1234, receipt 88 or a lot address
trilha.ajuda: Type the name of a collector, cooperative or industry to see its lots. With a donation or sale receipt, type the reference as it appears on the document (invoice, receipt or tax ID); case and extra spaces do not matter. A lot or wallet address also works.
trilha.nada: Nothing found with that name, reference or address.
trilha.naoVinculado: Not in a sale lot yet.
trilha.origens: Source lots that make up this lot
trilha.naoConsumido: Not consumed by the industry yet.
trilha.erro: Could not reach the blockchain right now. Try again in a moment.
trilha.limite: Showing {{n}} of {{total}} results. Refine the search to see the rest.

coletor.soColetor: This screen is for wallets registered as collectors.
coletor.vazio: No source lot registered with your wallet yet.
coletor.qrTitulo: QR code of the collector wallet
coletor.qrAjuda: Show this code to the cooperative when you deliver or sell material. They scan it and the source lot is registered in your name. The code carries only the wallet address, no personal data.
